name: Planar Wild Shape
description: Spend an extra wild shape use to add the celestial or fiendish template to an animal wild shape form (DM ruling for this table: 3.5 Monster Manual template stat blocks, and Lyra may pick either template per use regardless of alignment). Not modeled — the wild shape template pipeline (greenbound, advanced, giant, young) doesn't yet have a celestial/fiendish entry.
